doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: Marriage in 1910, Spanish-American War and World War I
summary: Bailey married at 21 in 1910, recalls no Spanish-American War, and says he was scheduled for the draft in World War I.
